title: A huge clock tower?
content: Okay, I just remembered this dream from years and years back, but there is this area not a very big area, on one side of the mall, one of the sides where the parking lots arent, and it just leads out to city streets, but at this part, there's cobbled streets To the right and left, the further you go, the buildings just get bigger and bigger, and on the far side there is a forest. There's a big circle with nothing in it in the middle of this area, just cobblestone streets and people walking through. On the one side of this that's closer to the tall buildings, there is a giant clocktower with exposed gears, all silver with hints of brass here and there, and grey stonework going up the sides. Occasionally it makes little noises, but I don't think I've ever seen it move. At the base, there is a little hardware store, that sells all manner of tools and home repair items. There is a big front desk made of a faded wood off to the right of the door, and the store seems to go back much further than the outside suggests. The shelves are all cluttered and crowded and when I talked to the man at the front, he said that everyone finds what they need. Has anyone else seen this or is it just me?
